name: worktree-prefix
description: Puts `claude -w` worktrees on a branch named <prefix><worktree name>, with the prefix read from `git config miscClaudePlugins.worktreePrefix` instead of the built-in "worktree-". A SessionStart hook registers the WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks that do it in the user settings file, which is the only place Claude Code reads them early enough.
